pairs: Post hæc autem ambulabat Jesus in Galilæam:
Then, after these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee.
non enim volebat in Judæam ambulare,
For he was not willing to walk in Judea,
because the Jews were seeking to kill him.
Erat autem in proximo dies festus Judæorum,
Now the feast day of the Jews, the Feast of Tabernacles,
Dixerunt autem ad eum fratres ejus:
And his brothers said to him:
Transi hinc, et vade in Judæam,
“Move away from here and go into Judea,
ut et discipuli tui videant opera tua, quæ facis.
so that your disciples there may also see your works that you do.
Nemo quippe in occulto quid facit,
Of course, no one does anything in secret,
et quærit ipse in palam esse:
but he himself seeks to be in the public view.
Neque enim fratres ejus credebant in eum.
For neither did his brothers believe in him.
tempus autem vestrum semper est paratum.
but your time is always at hand.
quia ego testimonium perhibeo de illo quod opera ejus mala sunt.
because I offer testimony about it, that its works are evil.
Vos ascendite ad diem festum hunc,
You may go up to this feast day.
ego autem non ascendo ad diem festum istum:
But I am not going up to this feast day,
quia meum tempus nondum impletum est.
because my time has not yet been fulfilled.”
When he had said these things,
But after his brothers went up,
then he also went up to the feast day,
et ipse ascendit ad diem festum non manifeste,
Judæi ergo quærebant eum in die festo,
Therefore, the Jews were seeking him on the feast day,
and they were saying, “Where is he?”
Et murmur multum erat in turba de eo.
And there was much murmuring in the crowd concerning him.
Nemo tamen palam loquebatur de illo propter metum Judæorum.
Yet no one was speaking openly about him, out of fear of the Jews.
Then, about the middle of the feast,
ascendit Jesus in templum, et docebat.
Jesus ascended into the temple, and he was teaching.
though he has not been taught?”
but of him who sent me.
Si quis voluerit voluntatem ejus facere,
If anyone has chosen to do his will, then he will realize,
or whether I am speaking from myself.
Qui a semetipso loquitur, gloriam propriam quærit;
Whoever speaks from himself seeks his own glory.
qui autem quærit gloriam ejus qui misit eum,
But whoever seeks the glory of him who sent him,
et injustitia in illo non est.
and injustice is not in him.
Did not Moses give you the law?
et nemo ex vobis facit legem?
And yet not one among you keeps the law!
Why are you seeking to kill me?”
Who is seeking to kill you?”
Jesus responded and said to them:
propterea Moyses dedit vobis circumcisionem (non quia ex Moyse est,
but of the fathers) and on the Sabbath you circumcise a man.
Si circumcisionem accipit homo in sabbato,
If a man can receive circumcision on the Sabbath,
so that the law of Moses may not be broken,
mihi indignamini quia totum hominem sanum feci in sabbato?
why are you indignant toward me, because I have made a man whole on the Sabbath?
Do not judge according to appearances,
but instead judge a just judgment.”
some of those from Jerusalem said:
“Is he not the one whom they are seeking to kill?
And behold, he is speaking openly,
and they say nothing to him.
Numquid vere cognoverunt principes quia hic est Christus?
Could the leaders have decided that it is true this one is the Christ?
But we know him and where he is from.
And when the Christ has arrived,
no one will know where he is from.”
Clamabat ergo Jesus in templo docens,
Therefore, Jesus cried out in the temple, teaching and saying:
Et me scitis, et unde sim scitis:
and you also know where I am from.
et a meipso non veni, sed est verus qui misit me,
And I have not arrived of myself, but he who sent me is true,
and him you do not know.
Therefore, they were seeking to apprehend him,
et nemo misit in illum manus,
and yet no one laid hands on him,
because his hour had not yet come.
De turba autem multi crediderunt in eum,
But many among the crowd believed in him,
numquid plura signa faciet quam quæ hic facit?
will he perform more signs than this man does?”
Audierunt pharisæi turbam murmurantem de illo hæc:
The Pharisees heard the crowd murmuring these things about him.
et miserunt principes et pharisæi ministros ut apprehenderent eum.
And the leaders and the Pharisees sent attendants to apprehend him.
“For a brief time, I am still with you,
et vado ad eum qui me misit.
and then I am going to him who sent me.
and you will not find me.
you are not able to go.”
And so the Jews said among themselves:
“Where is this place to which he will go,
such that we will not find him?
numquid in dispersionem gentium iturus est,
Will he go to those dispersed among the Gentiles
quis est hic sermo, quem dixit:
What is this word that he spoke,
‘You will seek me and you will not find me;
you are not able to go?’”
In novissimo autem die magno festivitatis stabat Jesus,
Then, on the last great day of the feast, Jesus was standing and crying out,
et clamabat dicens: Si quis sitit,
let him come to me and drink:
flumina de ventre ejus fluent aquæ vivæ.
‘From his chest shall flow rivers of living water.’”
Now he said this about the Spirit,
quem accepturi erant credentes in eum:
which those who believe in him would soon be receiving.
For the Spirit had not yet been given,
because Jesus had not yet been glorified.
Ex illa ergo turba cum audissent hos sermones ejus,
Therefore, some from that crowd, when they had heard these words of his,
nonne Scriptura dicit: Quia ex semine David, et de Bethlehem castello,
Does Scripture not say that the Christ comes from the offspring of David and from Bethlehem,
Dissensio itaque facta est in turba propter eum.
And so there arose a dissension among the multitude because of him.
Quidam autem ex ipsis volebant apprehendere eum:
Now certain ones among them wanted to apprehend him,
sed nemo misit super eum manus.
but no one laid hands upon him.
the attendants went to the high priests and the Pharisees.
Numquam sic locutus est homo, sicut hic homo.
“Never has a man spoken like this man.”
And so the Pharisees answered them:
numquid ex principibus aliquis credidit in eum,
Have any of the leaders believed in him,
which does not know the law,
ille qui venit ad eum nocte,
the one who came to him by night and who was one of them,
unless it has first heard him
and has known what he has done?”
et vide quia a Galilæa propheta non surgit.
and see that a prophet does not arise from Galilee.”
Et reversi sunt unusquisque in domum suam.
And each one returned to his own house.
